items.title: T-Mobile US (TMUS) Extends Satellite Service As Its Valuation Story Stays In Focus
items.summary: T-Mobile US (TMUS) is in the spotlight after extending its T-Satellite with Starlink texting service across the Hawaiian Islands ahead of storm Lala, while also pushing deeper into app-led retail interactions and restructuring its store footprint. T-Mobile US has been reshaping how it serves customers through the T-Life app and store closures while also using satellite partnerships with Starlink to support resilience in areas like Hawaii.
